activePlan.objective: Repair the repository identifier guard exposed by Nexus PR #119 so valid GitHub repository names ending in a hyphen can pass the mandatory Crucible gate without weakening URL-injection protections.
steps: Reproduce the hosted failure for GITHUB_REPOSITORY=jonathanblunt1214-lgtm/Nexus- and isolate it to src/apiGuard.js.

Separate the owner and repository segment rules so an owner cannot end in a hyphen while the repository may, retaining the single owner/repository shape and the existing URL/path-injection rejections.
Add regression coverage for Nexus- and an unsafe trailing-hyphen owner, update the README and shared handoff, then run the complete deterministic verification set.
Push only to development, confirm hosted Self-Test and CodeQL, and provide the verified immutable commit for the explicitly authorized Nexus gate repair.

completed: Confirmed the PR-native Nexus gate reaches the collision step and fails only because the valid repository identifier jonathanblunt1214-lgtm/Nexus- is rejected.
Updated the guard and regression tests without relaxing rejection of schemes, queries, traversal, whitespace, or extra path segments.
verification: Full local suite passes 172/172, including the new Nexus- regression and all existing unsafe-identifier cases.
lint:workflows, docs:check, validate, audit:clutter, audit:privacy, audit:security, and audit:ai-conflict-governance all pass.
git diff --check passes. The standalone handoff command correctly refused invocation without its required exact 40-character base/head range; CI supplies that changed range.
remaining: Commit and push the handoff-complete repair to development, then verify hosted CI before updating the Nexus immutable pin.
